issues.problem: Grammatically impossible: aḥ before s stays aḥ, it never gives "gavyo ṣu", and the retroflex ṣ shows the preceding vowel is u/o. The sequence is gavyā (lengthened 2 sg. imperative of the denominative gavya- "seek cattle", exactly parallel to aśvayā, rathayā, varivasyā in the same verse) + u + su. The draft takes gavyaḥ as a nominative with three imperatives, which also forces the English "Desirous of cattle" and drops the particle u.
issues.fix: Words of token gavyo: gavyā "seek cattle" (2 sg. impv. denom. gavya-, lengthened) + u "indeed".

value.gram: 2 sg. impv. denom. √gavya (lengthened), parallel to aśvayā, rathayā

summary: 49 units (145-193), all two-line verses; grouping is fine, no regrouping. 6 error and 32 minor issues in 30 units. Main errors: 186 (gavyā u su analysed as nominative gavyaḥ; whole verse retranslated), 160 and 163 (√hū mislabelled √hu), 145 (yavāśiraḥ case), 179 (contested count 'ninety-nine' stated as fact). Others: unsupported additions in Hindi/English (153, 161, 167, 176, 183, 187, 193), Hindi/English disagreements (147, 148, 155, 189), dropped ca (188), sandhi forms left as w (147, 152, 193). Very obscure verses (145, 148, 149, 151, 154, 166, 170, 172, 175, 183, 187) correctly low confidence.
